verdict.rationale: Vue's own docs describe lazy hydration for server-rendered apps in Vue 3.5+. Async components can be given a hydration strategy, and the built-in options are hydrateOnIdle, hydrateOnVisible, hydrateOnMediaQuery and hydrateOnInteraction, with custom strategies also supported. This is first-party progressive hydration. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that it works in practice, and evidence of measured gains in time-to-interactive.

support.subject: As a developer, I can hydrate my server-rendered app progressively so pages become interactive faster

citations.quote: In Vue 3.5+, async components can control when they are hydrated by providing a hydration strategy. Vue provides a number of built-in hydration strategies.
